messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ingress-us-west gateway error-rate spike (5xx) — 12.3% errors last 60s, p95 latency 1.2s. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/ingress-us-west?range=5m

Eric (oncall): I got paged, jumping in.

Maria: seeing the same. Large uptick in 502/504 from our edge->origin hop. RPS steady, but cache hit rate for kvcache-usw dropped from ~82% to ~6% in the last 90s.

Jonathan: FYI I merged a small runtime flag (prefetch-v2) to us-west cluster at 1729456640 — it reduced TTL on some cache keys to 2s to test freshness. Rollout was staged but looks like it hit more hosts than intended. I rolled it back at 1729456700 but the cache storm already started.

Shiv: confirming logs from kvcache show mass misses and backend retries. snippet of recent error lines:
```
[ingress-usw] 2025-03-20T17:46:05Z ERROR backend_request failed status=502 upstream=origin-12
[kvcache] miss key=prompt:abc123 ttl=2ms backend_retry=3
```
Miss amplification causing origin to return 502 under load.

Maria: mitigation plan proposal: 1) bump kvcache TTL back to 30s for hot prefixes, 2) scale kvcache replicas in us-west + temporarily route a portion of traffic to eu-west, 3) abort any ongoing prefetch or invalidation jobs.

Eric (oncall): I'll execute the TTL bump and scale. Lina, can you coordinate cross-region routing if needed?

Lina (oncall): on it. Preparing a targeted traffic steer to eu-west-1 at 20% using the edge-route weight matrix. Will keep SSL and header fidelity.

SRE-Bot: Runbook step executed: enabled circuit-breaker-backoff for ingress per docs/ingress/circuit-breakers. See logs for actions.

Shiv: running the kubectl commands now.
```bash
# increase TTL config in runtime-config map
kubectl -n redwood set env configmap/kvcache-runtime TTL_HOT_PREFIX=30 --context=us-west
# scale kvcache
kubectl -n redwood scale deployment/kvcache-usw --replicas=6 --context=us-west
```
Applying...

Maria: I'm watching origin error rates. If we can get hit-rate back above ~60% we should see 5xx fall under 2%.

Amy (cust-success): customer-impact summary: initial scrape shows ~14 customers with >50% error rate in the last 5m, two customers (AcmeCorp, BeaconHealth) have broad impact across regions for some endpoints. We'll prepare a short status note for affected customers if this goes past 30m. Please flag when we have ETA for full mitigation.

Eric (oncall): TTL bump applied at 1729456890, scaling started. Observability: cache hit-rate climbing to 28% now. Origin 5xx dropping from 12% -> 7%

Jonathan: double-checking that no invalidation job is still queued — I found a background invalidation task that was extending across clusters, cancelling now.

Lina (oncall): I've pushed 20% traffic steer to eu-west at 1729456942. Monitoring latency and error parity.

SRE-Bot: Traffic steering change recorded: steer_id=ts-20250320-01, new weights: us-west=80, eu-west=20.

Maria: nice — combined effect looks good. Cache hit-rate ~58% and 5xx ~2.1% at 1729457000. Keep an eye for regressions while we stabilize.

Amy (cust-success): drafting customer comms now. Notifying top affected accounts with ETA "mitigation in progress, monitoring; next update in 30m".

Eric (oncall): Handing off to Amanda for monitoring and post-incident followup — I need to jump to a paged infra incident. Amanda, you have the lead at 1729456970.

Amanda (oncall): taking over. I'll keep the steer at 20% for 15 minutes, then ramp down if metrics stay stable. Please post any remaining logs/errors here.

Shiv: cache hit-rate holding ~62% and origin 5xx stabilized ~1.8% at 1729457055. No new error bursts in the last 3m.

Amanda (oncall): OK switching to recovery plan: 1) revert temporary steer gradually after 15m 2) keep TTL at 30s for an hour then roll changes through a safer staged rollout 3) postmortem to root-cause the prefetched TTL change and improve rollout guardrails. Assign action items.

Maria: capturing action items: A) rollback gating for runtime flags (jonathan) B) add pre-deploy chaos test for kvcache miss amplification (shiv) C) customer comms follow-up (amy) D) postmortem and RCA doc (amanda).

Amy (cust-success): will send a targeted follow-up to AcmeCorp & BeaconHealth with root cause summary and mitigation steps once RCA drafted.

incident-bot: Incident severity updated to SEV-2 at 1729457100 (partial regional impact). Pager duty notes appended.

Amanda (oncall): closing the active paging loop — monitoring only. If error rate spikes again, re-escalate. Will open postmortem and timeline in #postmortems within 24h. Good work team :thumbsup:
